build_resnext_model: build a ResNeXt model with custom num_blocks, cardinality, and bottleneck_width for CIFAR-10 classification
create_resnext_block: create a grouped convolution Block with configurable cardinality, bottleneck_width, and stride for residual learning
test_resnext_forward_pass: test the ResNeXt29_2x64d model by running a random 32x32 image through the network
